comment: Single source of the app mark (stacked session cards, not a Claude/Anthropic logo). Used by the in-app AppMark and by scripts/generate-icon.mjs for build/icon.png + build/icon.ico. Run `yarn icon` after changing it. `codex`: the same shape in Codex's blue, drawn in the app while Codex is on screen (the installed icon keeps `color`).
